title: Most Servers on the Planet Are Vulnerable to This Firmware Code-Execution Flaw
description: The critical flaw in UEFI firmware—used by most server vendors and data centers—allows attackers to execute code early in the boot process.

content.summary: The critical flaw in UEFI firmware—used by most server vendors and data centers—allows attackers to execute code early in the boot process....
content.impact: The implications of this cybersecurity update are significant for digital infrastructure in Tier-1 nations. Experts suggest that such developments could influence both consumer behavior and enterprise-level security protocols in the US, UK, CA, and AU markets.

Attackers can execute code early in the boot process due to this vulnerability.
